description_en: Lists the content of a specific log file of a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) trial by pages
description_zh: 分页显示一个hpo trial的一个指定日治的内容
kebab_example: aliyun paiautoml list-hpo-trial-logs --experiment-id abcde --trial-id asdf --log-name trial.log --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHpoTrialLogs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the HPO experiment
parameters.name: experiment_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the log. Valid values: stderr, stdout, and trial.log
parameters.name: log_name

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. If you leave this parameter empty, all content in the log file is returned
parameters.help_zh: 页码。起始值：1。不填则返回log文件里所有内容
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of log entries returned on each page. The value must be a positive integer. If you leave this parameter empty, all content in the log file is returned
parameters.help_zh: 每页包含的日志行数。正整数。不填则返回log文件里所有内容
parameters.name: page_size

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the HPO experiment
v1_parameters.name: ExperimentId

v1_parameters.help_en: The name of the log. Valid values: stderr, stdout, and trial.log
v1_parameters.name: LogName

v1_parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. If you leave this parameter empty, all content in the log file is returned
v1_parameters.help_zh: 页码。起始值：1。不填则返回log文件里所有内容
v1_parameters.name: PageNumber

v1_parameters.help_en: The number of log entries returned on each page. The value must be a positive integer. If you leave this parameter empty, all content in the log file is returned
